text:
maggie.ops: FYI seeing a surge of IPMI auth failures in us-west2 since 02:14 UTC. BMC keystore rotation kicked off and a bunch of canary hosts failed to re-auth. GPU provisioning is getting queued.

infra-bot: [ALERT] 02:15 UTC - ipmi_auth_failures > 500/min (us-west2). Created incident INC-2024-0822.

sam.infra: on it, pulling logs and checking the rollout control plane. can you dump a few failed bmc logs?

jordan-plat: paste from one host: ```
[2024-08-22T02:14:37Z] ipmi: auth_verify: signature mismatch key_id=rot-2024-08-22 nonce=0x7a3b
[2024-08-22T02:14:37Z] ipmi: session close uid=0x8a err=AUTH_FAIL
```

dmitri-sre: looks like the keystore rotation produced a key id that old BMC firmware doesn't accept (nonce/format change). this matches the matrix of older iLO/iDRAC revisions.

maggie.ops: that explains why only a subset of racks are affected (older platforms in rack rows 3-6). provisioning queue depth at 02:30 UTC: 420 jobs waiting (mostly GPU allocate).

carmen-eng: immediate mitigation options?

sam.infra: short term: pause the keystore rotation controller and re-publish the previous keystore snapshot to the affected BMCs, then kick a reauth. doing full re-provision of keys will require a maintenance window if we need manual BMC reflash.

jordan-plat: quick command we used to re-trigger auth on a single host (manual):
```bash
# force keystore reload and reauth attempt
kubectl exec -n oob svc/bmc-proxy -- sh -c \"curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/reload-keystore?host=bd-node-34\"
# then check ipmi status
ipmitool -I lanplus -H bd-node-34 -U admin -P <rotated-secret> chassis status
```

dmitri-sre: note: some BMCs reject the new key format and return a nonce_mismatch error; for those we need vendor firmware patch or to fall back to legacy key alg. I'll enumerate impacted firmware versions and attach to the incident.

maggie.ops: cost note — queued GPU minutes accumulating. rough estimate since 02:20 UTC ~9,000 GPU-minutes queued (~$1.1k) if this holds. we should prioritize jobs for paid customers and backfill internal batch later.

infra-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-2024-0822 updated: status=investigating, severity=high, region=us-west2, impact=provisioning-delay, ETA-next-update=02:45 UTC.

carmen-eng: plan proposal:
- pause global rotation controller (sam)
- publish previous keystore snapshot to control-plane (jordan)
- run batched reauth on affected rack subset (dmitri)
- temporary routing: divert new provisioning requests to eu-west1/us-central1 if capacity available (maggie)
- schedule 60m maintenance to run vendor fw patch for affected BMC models (carmen)

sam.infra: pausing rotation controller now: `kubectl scale deployment keystore-rotator --replicas=0 -n infra`

sam.infra: done. controller scaled to 0 — no new rotations will be issued.

jordan-plat: published previous snapshot id `ksnap-20240818-v3` to control plane and started batch reapply to racks 3-6. I've kicked the first 50 nodes.

dmitri-sre: running reauth script in batches of 50 with 5s stagger to avoid IPMI connection storms. snippet:```bash
for n in $(cat affected_nodes_chunk1); do 
  ipmitool -I lanplus -H $n -U admin -P \"$LEGACY_KEY\" chassis status &
  sleep 5
done
```

maggie.ops: early telemetry: reauth success rate 72% for batch1, still ~28% failing (likely firmware). provisioning backlog dropped 20% after first batch.

carmen-eng: good. escalate failing hosts to hw-vendor support with list and logs. I'll book the 60m maintenance window at 04:30 UTC to apply vendor FW or schedule cold reboots if needed.

infra-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-2024-0822 assigned: sam.infra, dmitri-sre, jordan-plat, carmen-eng. Next update at 02:55 UTC.

maggie.ops: action items recorded. postmortem owner needed — volunteering: carmen-eng. please include cost impact and rollout guard improvements (canary sizing + firmware compatibility matrix).

carmen-eng: taking postmortem. early remediation: add a firmware-compat check to the keystore rotator (block rotate if >1% hosts in target env have incompatible BMC revisions).

sam.infra: I'll open a CI job to test new keystore formats against a matrix of BMC firmware images before any global rotation.

dmitri-sre: collecting full affected host list and starting vendor escalations now.

jordan-plat: linking runbook: https://go.internal/runbooks/oob-keystore-rotation (internal) — follow steps 1-6 for staged recovery.

maggie.ops: thanks team. ping here when the backlog is below 50 jobs and we can close the incident. :thumbsup:
